items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: she was wonderful on top of the group

ctx.x: A little Norwegian milkmaid from upstate New York. She came out full blown, she could play the piano, she could sing, she had a very – her pitch was so great, that she was wonderful on top of the group. And yeah, that’s what she was doing first.
So she introduced you to Gil?
